title: Persona slug normalization for tag and id-list fields

sections.what: Automatically normalize id-list inputs in the Persona tab and import pipeline to valid lower-case kebab-case/snake-case slugs (`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]*$`) rather than rejecting unnormalized typed input or letting uppercase display strings enter the tag arrays.
sections.why: Id-list fields (`likes`, `dislikes`, `fears`, `interests`, `kinks`, `turn_ons`, `turn_offs`, `traumas`, `boundaries`, `traits`, `aspirations`, `quirks`, `habits`) must be tag slugs for engine consumers to match them against world entities and tags. Users naturally type `"Dark Caves"` or `"Monster energy drink"`, which currently fails validation or bypasses checks.
sections.how:
- Add `normalize_slug(value: str) -> str` in `engine/character_appearance.py` that trims, lowercases, replaces non-alphanumeric punctuation with underscores, and strips illegal symbols.
- In `static/js/inspector/mind-view.ts`, apply slug normalization on chip creation so typed tags transform smoothly.
- Add unit tests verifying slug conversion across spaces, special characters, and diacritics.

acceptance.text: Typing spaces or mixed-case into Persona id-list fields normalizes to valid tag slugs.
Backend validator normalizes or rejects malformed slugs deterministically.
Unit tests cover slug normalization rules and edge cases.
